entries.name: 30 Day // RC4 TGS Requestor Accounts
entries.description: Finds accounts requesting Kerberos TGS tickets using weak RC4/DES encryption (encryptAlgo 0x17 or 0x3) over last 30 days
entries.key_technique: metrics_string array indexing for EAT access

entries.name: ali-external-ip2
entries.description: Finds external (non-RFC1918) source IPs for Windows network logon type 3 in last 24 hours
entries.key_technique: toString(srcIpAddr) LIKE exclusions for private IP ranges

entries.name: A sample raw message for each reporting device and event type
entries.description: Collects one sample raw message per device+eventType pair seen in last 1 hour using ANY() aggregate function
entries.key_technique: any() function for representative sample, GROUP BY ALL shorthand

entries.name: Chris's ADM User Locked Out
entries.description: Finds workstations with cached credentials that locked out user admcsantana in last 24 hours
entries.key_technique: indexOf(metrics_string.name, 'field') > 0 guard before value access

entries.name: ClickHouse Storage Usage per Device Group
entries.description: Calculates disk bytes per CMDB device group (Network/Server/Cloud/Others) using fsiem.mv_events materialized view
entries.key_technique: dictHas() for CMDB group lookup, cluster() for distributed query, CTE WITH blocks

entries.name: ClickHouse Storage Usage per Retention Policy
entries.description: Calculates total ClickHouse disk bytes per retention policy bucket from system.parts
entries.key_technique: extract(partition, regex) for partition parsing, cluster() system.parts query

entries.name: ClickHouse Storage Usage Trend per Retention Policy
entries.description: Daily trend of disk bytes per retention policy bucket from system.parts
entries.key_technique: toStartOfDay(min_time) for daily bucketing of partition metadata

entries.name: ClickHouse Total and Used Online Storage
entries.description: Calculates total and used storage bytes across all local ClickHouse disks
entries.key_technique: system.disks with is_remote=0 filter, cluster() for distributed

entries.name: Decline in events from a reporting device
entries.description: Finds devices reporting 50%+ fewer events in the last hour vs 4-hour rolling average; excludes devices with <10 events/hr
entries.key_technique: Window function avg() OVER ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING for rolling average

entries.name: Dominating Firewalls Today
entries.description: Identifies firewall devices sending 50%+ more events today than the average of all other firewalls (ratio > 1.5)
entries.key_technique: Window sum() OVER ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING/FOLLOWING for per-device comparison, dictHas CMDB group filter

entries.name: Dominating Windows Servers today
entries.description: Identifies Windows servers sending 50%+ more events today than the average of all other Windows servers
entries.key_technique: Same window function pattern as Dominating Firewalls, CMDB group PH_SYS_DEVICE_WINDOWS_SERVER

entries.name: Events on epicbackupmhtc in last 24
entries.description: Finds all events mentioning epicbackupmhtc and session 25141 in raw message over last 24 hours
entries.key_technique: rawEventMsg LIKE '%keyword%' for full-text search on raw log

entries.name: Existing Devices not reporting today
entries.description: Finds devices seen in last 7 days that have NOT reported today; uses CTE anti-join pattern
entries.key_technique: GLOBAL NOT IN subquery anti-join with SETTINGS transform_null_in=1

entries.name: FortiADC: WAF Signature Events with URL containing Base64 encoded characters
entries.description: Detects FortiADC WAF hits where the infoURL contains URL-encoded (%) characters; decodes and counts them
entries.key_technique: countSubstrings() + decodeURLComponent() on metrics_string array field

entries.name: FortiADC: WAF Signature Events with URL containing GTFOBins
entries.description: Detects FortiADC WAF hits where decoded URL matches a GTFOBins process name via CROSS JOIN lookup table
entries.key_technique: CROSS JOIN fsiem.GTFOBin_0 lookup table with match() regex for process name detection

entries.name: How many logon events have source IPs
entries.description: Counts Win-Security-4624 events in last hour showing total, those with srcIpAddr, human users, and srcIP percentage
entries.key_technique: countIf() for conditional aggregation, NULL/empty checks on IP fields

entries.name: Linux: GTFOBin Process Created
entries.description: Detects Linux process executions matching GTFOBins tool names via CROSS JOIN lookup table
entries.key_technique: CROSS JOIN fsiem.GTFOBin_0 with match() for word-boundary process name matching

entries.name: Most Frequent Reporting Device and Event Types today
entries.description: Approximate Top 10 device+eventType combos today using topK() aggregate (faster than GROUP BY + ORDER BY)
entries.key_technique: topK(10)(concat(field1,'-',field2)) for approximate heavy hitters

entries.name: Most Frequent Sources with DNS activity today
entries.description: Approximate Top 10 source IPs with DNS traffic today using topK(); includes both DNS server events and firewall port-53 events
event_types: DNS event groups via dictHas CMDB
entries.key_technique: topK(10)(srcIpAddrV4) with complex CMDB event group filtering for DNS categories

entries.name: New device reporting today
entries.description: Finds devices reporting today that were NOT seen at all in the previous 7 days
entries.key_technique: GLOBAL NOT IN CTE anti-join with SETTINGS transform_null_in=1

entries.name: New FortiSIEM Audit Event today
entries.description: Finds PH_AUDIT* event types seen today that never appeared in the previous 7 days
entries.key_technique: GLOBAL NOT IN subquery anti-join on eventType baseline

entries.name: New FortiSIEM Operational error today
entries.description: Finds new PHL_ERROR operational messages today (not in PH_DISCOV) never seen in previous 7 days, keyed on eventType+procName+fileName+lineNumber
entries.key_technique: Tuple NOT IN subquery: (eventType, procName, fileName, lineNumber) multi-field anti-join

entries.name: New Windows Ports Opening Today
entries.description: Detects PH_OSQUERY_WIN_PROCESS_PORT events for host+port combinations not seen in previous 7 days (name missing in source file)
entries.key_technique: Tuple NOT IN subquery: (hostName, destIpPort) anti-join
entries.note: Entry in source file is missing Name line

entries.name: New incident today
entries.description: Finds (eventType, incidentSrc, incidentTarget) incident combinations today not seen in previous 7 days
entries.key_technique: Tuple NOT IN subquery on 3-field incident key

entries.name: Sample of Unknown Events per Reporting IP
entries.description: Returns 10 most recent Unknown_EventType events per reporting IP using ROW_NUMBER() window function
entries.key_technique: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY reptDevIpAddrV4 ORDER BY phRecvTime DESC) for per-device top-N

entries.name: Spike in daily new incidents
entries.description: Lists days last week where incident count exceeds 50% of the same weekday's average from prior 4 weeks
entries.key_technique: PARTITION BY day_of_week with ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING for weekday-aligned baseline

entries.name: Spike in events from a reporting device
entries.description: Identifies devices reporting 50%+ more events in last hour vs 4-hour rolling average
entries.key_technique: Window avg() OVER ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING, ratio > 1.5 filter

entries.name: Spike in event types from a device
entries.description: Identifies device+eventType combinations spiking 50%+ in last hour vs 4-hour rolling average (name missing in source file)
entries.key_technique: Window function partitioned by (reptDevName, reptDevIP, eventType)
entries.note: Entry in source file is missing Name line

entries.name: Spike in inbound denied network traffic to a destination host
entries.description: Detects destination IPs receiving 50%+ more deny events yesterday vs 7-day daily average
entries.key_technique: Window avg() OVER ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING; dictHas DenyTraffic group filter

entries.name: Spike in network traffic from a source
entries.description: Detects source IPs sending 50%+ more permitted network traffic yesterday vs 7-day daily average
entries.key_technique: Window avg ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING; permit+binetflow CMDB groups

entries.name: Spike in outbound denied network traffic from a source
entries.description: Detects source IPs getting denied 50%+ more times yesterday vs 7-day daily average
entries.key_technique: Window avg ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING; DenyTraffic group filter

entries.name: Spike in outbound network activity to one destination country
entries.description: Detects destination countries receiving 50%+ more denied traffic yesterday vs 7-day daily average
entries.key_technique: destGeoCountry geo field with window avg baseline

entries.name: Spike in SMB Connection from a source
entries.description: Detects sources sending 50%+ more SMB traffic (ports 139/445) yesterday vs 7-day daily average
entries.key_technique: destIpPort IN (139, 445) filter combined with permit/binetflow CMDB groups

entries.name: SVC Creds Changed
entries.description: Finds password reset events (4724) for accounts containing 'svc' or 'service' in username in last 7 days
entries.key_technique: lower() + LIKE for case-insensitive service account name pattern matching

entries.name: Top 10 Event Types by count and their proportions
entries.description: Top 10 event types by count with percentage of total in last 10 minutes
entries.key_technique: SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () window for percentage of total calculation

entries.name: Top 10 Incidents and actors by event count and their proportion
entries.description: Top 10 incident types with actors (src/dest/user) by count and percentage in last 1 day
entries.key_technique: sum(count) AS incident_count with window SUM OVER () for pct, phEventCategory 1 and 100

entries.name: Top 10 Reporting devices by event count and their proportions
entries.description: Top 10 reporting devices by external/flow event count with percentage in last 10 minutes
entries.key_technique: COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () for percentage

entries.name: Top 10 Reporting devices by event size
entries.description: Top 10 reporting devices by raw event size (MB) in last 10 minutes
entries.key_technique: round(SUM(rawEventSize / (1024*1024)), 2) for MB conversion from rawEventSize bytes

entries.name: Top Failed Windows/Linux logins by count
entries.description: Top 100 failed Windows or Linux SSH login combinations by count in last 1 day
entries.key_technique: IN clause for multi-eventType filter, GROUP BY 6 fields

entries.name: Top Inbound Permit Destinations
entries.description: Top inbound permit traffic (external src → internal dest) by source country, dest IP, and port in last 1 hour
entries.key_technique: IPv6 range comparisons on metrics_ip array for public/private IP classification; PH_SYS_EVENT_PermitTraffic group

entries.name: Top Outbound Denied Sources
entries.description: Top outbound denied traffic (internal src → external dest) by src IP, dest country and port in last 1 hour
entries.key_technique: toIPv6() range checks on metrics_ip array for RFC1918 src/public dest classification

entries.name: Top Outbound Permit Traffic
entries.description: Top outbound permitted traffic (internal src → external dest) by src, dest IP, country and port in last 1 hour
entries.key_technique: Same toIPv6() range pattern; PH_SYS_EVENT_PermitTraffic CMDB group

entries.name: Top Successful and Failed Windows/Linux Logins by total count
entries.description: Per-user success and failure login counts in last 1 day; excludes machine accounts, SYSTEM, LOCAL SERVICE, NETWORK SERVICE, DWM-, UMDF-
entries.key_technique: SUM(IF(eventType IN (...), 1, 0)) conditional counting for pivoted success/fail in single query

entries.name: Unusual Device login today
entries.description: Finds (srcIP, user, reptDevName) login combinations today never seen in previous 2 weeks
entries.key_technique: 3-tuple GLOBAL NOT IN subquery anti-join; CMDB group PH_SYS_EVENT_HostLogonSuccess

entries.name: Unusual Windows RDP login today
entries.description: Finds RDP/Terminal Service logins (winLogonType=10) today from (srcIP, user, reptDev) combinations not seen in previous 2 weeks
entries.key_technique: winLogonType=10 filter; 3-tuple GLOBAL NOT IN; note srcIpAddr vs srcIpAddrV4 discrepancy in outer query

entries.name: Unusual Windows Service today
entries.description: Detects Windows services running from unexpected paths (serviceName+servicePath combo) not seen in previous 14 days
entries.key_technique: Nested WITH alias for metrics_string values; CTE with inner WITH for baseline; tuple NOT IN (name, path)

entries.name: Weak Auth - ALI
entries.description: Finds service accounts using weak Kerberos encryption (RC4/DES) in 4769 events over last 7 days using extractAll on rawEventMsg
entries.key_technique: extractAll(rawEventMsg, regex) for field extraction from raw XML message

entries.name: Weak Encryption Auth - Accounts
entries.description: Classifies weak Kerberos encryption (RC4=0x17, DES=0x3/0x1) in 4769 events with CASE labeling over last 7 days
entries.key_technique: CASE WHEN rawEventMsg LIKE '%TicketEncryptionType\'>0x17%' for classification from raw message

entries.name: What's Failing
entries.description: Failed logins grouped by account, domain, source host, failure reason and target server in last 24 hours
entries.key_technique: metrics_string array access for user, domain, srcName, errReason fields

entries.name: Who Got Admin
entries.description: Finds users added to admin/privileged groups (domain/local/universal) in last 7 days using CASE for group type
entries.key_technique: CASE eventType WHEN for group type labeling; lower() LIKE on targetUserGrp for admin group names

entries.name: Who's Getting Locked
entries.description: Account lockouts grouped by user, domain, DC with count and most recent lockout in last 24 hours
entries.key_technique: MAX(phRecvTime) for latest lockout timestamp alongside COUNT(*)

entries.name: Windows: Accounts Created and Deleted within the same Day in last week
entries.description: Detects accounts created AND deleted within the same day in last 7 days using INNER JOIN on reptDevName+targetUser
entries.data_source: Microsoft Windows Security Log via OMI or FortiSIEM Agent
entries.key_technique: INNER JOIN between creation/deletion CTEs on device+user; WITH TIME_RANGE constant for 1-day window check

entries.name: Windows: Base64 Encoded Commands
entries.description: Detects Sysmon process creation events with -EncodedCommand parameter; decodes the Base64 payload inline
entries.data_source: Microsoft Windows Sysmon via FortiSIEM Agent
entries.key_technique: base64Decode(regexpExtract(command, '-EncodedCommand\s+(.*)', 1)) for inline decode

entries.name: Windows: Base64 Encoded PowerShell Commands
entries.description: Detects PowerShell events with -EncodedCommand in appName; decodes the Base64 payload inline
entries.data_source: Microsoft Windows PowerShell Operational Logs via FortiSIEM Agent
entries.key_technique: base64Decode(regexpExtract(appName, '-EncodedCommand\\s+(.*)', 1)) on appName field

entries.name: Windows: Command Line Obfuscation using escape characters
entries.description: Scores commands on 13 obfuscation indicators (Unicode, split quoting, mixed case, excessive special chars, char functions) and returns huntScore >= 1
entries.data_source: Microsoft Windows Security Log, Sysmon via FortiSIEM Agent
entries.key_technique: countMatches() + positionCaseInsensitive() for multi-indicator scoring; HAVING huntScore >= 1

entries.name: Windows: LOLAD Active Directory Command Match
entries.description: Detects AD commands matching LOLAD project entries via CROSS JOIN; handles regex and plain-string patterns separately
entries.data_source: Microsoft Windows Security Log, Sysmon via FortiSIEM Agent
entries.key_technique: CROSS JOIN fsiem.LOLAD_0; conditional match() for regex patterns vs ILIKE for plain strings based on special char presence

entries.name: Windows: LOLBIN Process Creation
entries.description: Detects process names matching LOLBAS project using multiMatchAllIndices() for batch pattern matching; ARRAY JOIN to explode matches
entries.data_source: Microsoft Windows Security Log, Sysmon via FortiSIEM Agent
entries.key_technique: WITH lolbins array + patterns array; multiMatchAllIndices(cmd, patterns) + ARRAY JOIN for efficient multi-pattern matching

entries.name: Windows: LOLBIN Process launched from unexpected path
entries.description: Detects LOLBAS processes running from paths not matching expected paths defined in LOLBAS project
entries.data_source: Microsoft Windows Security Log, Sysmon via FortiSIEM Agent
entries.key_technique: arrayExists(path -> procName ILIKE ...) on splitByString(';', paths) for path validation; HAVING path_match_status='Path Mismatch'

entries.name: Windows: LOLBIN Process with command matching LOTS website
entries.description: Detects LOLBAS processes whose command line references a trusted site from the LOTS project (C2/exfil staging)
entries.data_source: Microsoft Windows Security Log, Sysmon via FortiSIEM Agent
entries.key_technique: Double CROSS JOIN (LOLBAS_0 + LOTS_0); shortProcName match + command ILIKE LOTS website check

entries.name: Windows: LOLBIN Process with outbound network connection to an external non-RFC1918 address
entries.description: Detects Sysmon network connection events from LOLBAS processes to external IP addresses
entries.data_source: Microsoft Windows Sysmon via FortiSIEM Agent
entries.key_technique: CROSS JOIN LOLBAS_0 with shortProcName ILIKE dict.lolbin; srcIpAddrV4 != destIpAddrV4 to exclude loopback

entries.name: Windows: Long Duration Terminal Services Sessions
entries.description: Tracks RDP/Terminal Services sessions lasting >1 hour by joining start/end events; shows duration, day name, and business hours classification
entries.data_source: Microsoft Windows Terminal Services LocalSessionManager/Operational logs via FortiSIEM Agent
entries.key_technique: Two CTEs with ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user, sessionId ORDER BY phRecvTime) for session matching; UNION ALL for NULL vs non-NULL source IP joins; formatDateTime('%w') for weekday names

entries.name: Windows: Suspicious PowerShell Cmdlet Match
entries.description: Detects PowerShell script block (4104) events containing cmdlets from MaliciousPowershellCmdlet lookup table
entries.data_source: Microsoft Windows Security Log, Sysmon via FortiSIEM Agent
entries.key_technique: CROSS JOIN fsiem.MaliciousPowershellCmdlet_0; match(script, CONCAT('(?i)(^|\\s)', dict.cmdlet, '(\\s|$)')) for word-boundary cmdlet detection
